source: Are you two sure you’ll be alright? You’re free to come with us if you want, you know…
translation: 你们两个确定没问题吗？如果愿意，也可以和我们一起去……

source: Ugh, give me a break! We don’t need you babysitting us!
translation: 呃，饶了我吧！我们不需要你照看！

source: Well, I just feel a little bad we have to leave on such short notice… Mr. Clermont really surprised us with this trip.
translation: 我只是觉得这么突然离开有些过意不去……Clermont先生安排的旅行真的让我们措手不及。

source: Don’t sweat it. It’s not like we’re sticking around the camp.
translation: 别担心。我们又不会留在营地。

source: We’re staying over at Keitaro’s place and our friends are gonna be there.
translation: 我们会住在Keitaro家，朋友们也都会去。

source: Ah, so it’s gonna be like a little reunion! It’s been a couple months since you’ve all been together – you must really miss each other!
translation: 啊，那就像一场小型重聚！你们已经几个月没聚在一起，一定很想念彼此！

source: I guess you could say that. It’ll be a good chance to catch up.
translation: 可以这么说。这是叙旧的好机会。

source: Yeah! And it’s more fun than being stuck here with you old geezers! I wouldn’t wanna go on your boring business trip!
translation: 是啊！而且比困在这里陪你们这些老家伙有趣！我才不想参加你们无聊的商务旅行！

source: Heck, the longer I can be away from this dump, the better!
translation: 见鬼，离这个破地方越久越好！

source: Haha, sounds like you’re very excited to see your friends, Yoichi~!
translation: 哈哈，听起来你非常期待见到朋友，Yoichi～！

source: Better than watching the grass die here.
translation: 总比留在这里看草枯死好。

source: It is getting colder every day too. Did you guys pack some warmer clothes?
translation: 天气也一天比一天冷。你们带御寒衣物了吗？

source: Duh! You should know I don’t pack my own stuff!
translation: 废话！你该知道我从不自己收拾行李！

source: Besides, we’re bringing the dogs too, and that’s enough work for me already!
translation: 而且还要带上那些狗，这已经够我忙了！

source: Ugh, can’t we just leave them here?
translation: 呃，就不能把它们留在这里吗？

source: Don’t be stupid, they’ll starve to death here! They’re coming with us, whether you like it or not.
translation: 别犯傻了，它们会在这里饿死！不管你喜不喜欢，它们都要和我们一起去。

source: Fine, fine! Just make sure they don’t come near me and slobber all over my face!
translation: 好，好！只要别让它们靠近我，把口水弄得我满脸都是！

source: A-Are you sure you two don’t need me to—
translation: 你、你们确定不需要我——

source: Yeah, stop worrying about us! Just go ahead already, everyone’s waiting for you out there!
translation: 是啊，别担心我们！快走吧，大家都在外面等你！

source: Alright, Taiga. I’ll leave you in charge of Yoichi…!
translation: 好吧，Taiga。Yoichi就交给你照看了……！

source: No one’s the boss of me!
translation: 没人能管我！

source: *sigh* Yoichi… Please try not to cause too much trouble, alright?
translation: *叹气* Yoichi……请尽量别惹太多麻烦，好吗？

source: Heh, you should know better by now, Yoshi.
translation: 呵，你现在应该早就了解他了，Yoshi。

source: I’ll see you two in a few days! Stay safe!
translation: 几天后见！注意安全！

source: There you are, Yoshi!
translation: 你终于来了，Yoshi！

source: Sorry for the delay, everyone! I was just making sure Yoichi and Taiga were all set before we left!
translation: 抱歉让大家久等！出发前我只是确认Yoichi和Taiga都安排妥当！

source: It’s fine. The shuttle just arrived anyway.
translation: 没关系。接驳车也才刚到。

source: Aww, I’m a little bummed they aren’t coming with us, though.
translation: 不过他们不和我们一起去，我还是有点失望。

source: Nah, they prefer to hang out with their friends – and that’s a good thing!
translation: 没事，他们更喜欢和朋友们一起玩——这是好事！

source: Yeah. Last year’s batch was definitely one of the closest groups we’ve ever had at the camp.
translation: 是啊。去年的那批营员绝对是营地有史以来关系最亲密的小组之一。

source: Hey, guys! We’ve finished loading up all the luggage!
translation: 嘿，各位！所有行李都装上车了！

source: Dibs on the window seat.
translation: 靠窗座位归我。

source: Wh-Wha?! I won’t get to see the view – you’re gonna block the whole window with your giant body!
translation: 什、什么？！我会看不到风景的——你那庞大的身体会挡住整扇窗！

source: There’s no point. You’ll end up sleeping, anyway.
translation: 没有意义。反正最后你会睡着。

source: Hmph! I’ll get there before you then!
translation: 哼！那我会抢在你前面！

source: No, you won’t.
translation: 你不会。

source: Speaking of sleep, did you get enough rest, Jin?
translation: 说到睡觉，你休息够了吗，Jin？

source: Ah, y-yeah! I’m sorry for passing out on you guys last night…!
translation: 啊，是、是的！昨晚在你们面前睡着，很抱歉……！

source: You were sleeping like a baby, so we didn’t want to bother you, haha!
translation: 你睡得像个婴儿，所以我们不想打扰你，哈哈！

source: It’s the first time this year I’ve had a normal sleep schedule. I’ll try to keep up with it, like I promised…!
translation: 这是我今年第一次拥有正常作息。我会像承诺的那样努力保持……！

source: Sleep whenever you like, Jin! Don’t let that Emilia tell you how to live your life!
translation: 想什么时候睡就什么时候睡，Jin！别让那个Emilia教你怎么生活！

source: *sigh* Yuri...
translation: *叹气* Yuri……

source: G-Good morning, Emilia. Do you need help with your—
translation: 早、早上好，Emilia。你的东西需要帮忙——

source: Don’t talk to me.
translation: 别和我说话。

source: Sheesh… Someone woke up the wrong side of the bed again, huh?
translation: 天啊……有人起床后心情又很糟，对吧？

source: Just ignore her! I’m not letting Ms. Sourpuss ruin this trip for us!
translation: 别理她！我绝不会让Sourpuss女士毁掉我们的旅行！

source: Jin and I already decided we’ll have a nice BL-reading session on the whole ride~!
translation: Jin 和我已经决定，整段路程都要愉快地阅读 BL～！

source: My laptop is all charged up and I brought my hard-drive too! We’ll go through my stash and watch the best BL dramas of all time!
translation: 我的笔记本电脑充满电了，硬盘也带上了！我们要翻遍我的收藏，观看史上最棒的 BL 剧！

source: Yieeee! Come on, let’s get going already!
translation: 耶——！来吧，我们快点出发！

source: Hehe, everyone’s super excited, huh?
translation: 嘿嘿，大家都特别兴奋，对吧？

source: Yeah, it feels like we’re going on a school field trip!
translation: 是啊，感觉像要去参加学校郊游！

source: Now I’m really curious about what kind of fun stuff we’ll see at that hotel~
translation: 现在我真的很好奇，会在那家酒店看到什么有趣的东西～

source: We should board the shuttle, then. We’ll find out once we get there.
translation: 那我们该上接驳车了。到那里就会知道。

source: Wow, Gramps can’t hide his excitement either, huh?
translation: 哇，Gramps也藏不住兴奋，对吧？

source: Alright, it’s gonna be a long ride! Who’s up for some snacks?
translation: 好了，路程会很长！谁想吃点零食？

source: I brought everyone’s favorites~! All homemade too!
translation: 我带了每个人最喜欢的东西～！而且全是自制的！

source: Wow, you didn’t have to do all of this, Aiden! But I’ll always say yes to your pulled pork sandwich!
translation: 哇，你不用准备这么多，Aiden！不过你的手撕猪肉三明治，我永远不会拒绝！

source: It’s barbecue~! Just how you like it!
translation: 是烧烤味～！正是你喜欢的口味！

source: Ooh! Ooh! I want some too!
translation: 哦！哦！我也想吃！

source: Calm down, there’s plenty for everyone~!
translation: 冷静，够所有人吃～！

source: This’ll be perfect with the chips I brought!
translation: 配上我带的薯片就完美了！

source: So much for healthy eating.
translation: 说好的健康饮食呢。

source: It’s not a field trip without some junk food! And besides, it’s my cheat day!
translation: 没有垃圾食品还算什么郊游！而且今天是我的放纵日！

source: I expect the hotel will have some nice food as well, so I’m betting today won’t be your only cheat day.
translation: 我想酒店也会有不错的食物，所以今天恐怕不会是你唯一的放纵日。

source: How about you, Jin? Want some?
translation: 你呢，Jin？想吃点吗？

source: *heaves*
translation: *干呕*

source: N-No, thank you…
translation: 不、不用了，谢谢……

source: Are you feeling unwell, Jin?
translation: 你不舒服吗，Jin？

source: It looks like he’s a little bit car sick…
translation: 看来他有点晕车……

source: The moment the bus started moving, he started gagging...
translation: 巴士一开动，他就开始干呕……

source: I-I’m sorry… I didn’t expect the bus ride would make my tummy turn…
translation: 对、对不起……没想到坐巴士会让我胃里翻江倒海……

source: Good thing I came prepared! Here’s some meds, Jin~! They might make you drowsy, though!
translation: 幸好我有准备！给你药，Jin～！不过可能会让你犯困！

source: Th-Thanks… I’ll take anything to end this suffering…
translation: 谢、谢谢……只要能结束这种痛苦，什么都行……

source: I brought some barf bags too in case you—
translation: 我还带了呕吐袋，以防你——

source: Aww, poor Jin…
translation: 啊，可怜的 Jin……

source: S-Sorry, Yuri… I know you wanted to watch BL movies…
translation: 对、对不起，Yuri……我知道你想看 BL 电影……

source: Oh dear, there’ll be plenty of other times for that!
translation: 哦，亲爱的，以后还有很多机会！

source: Just lay back and I’ll take care of you~
translation: 躺好吧，我会照顾你～

source: More snacks for us, then!
translation: 那我们能多吃点零食了！

source: Woo! It’s starting to snow! Look! Look!
translation: 哇！开始下雪了！快看！快看！

source: Lloyd, calm down. It’s just snow.
translation: Lloyd，冷静。只是雪。

source: Winter has finally come, huh? It’s a good thing our vacation is going to be mostly indoors.
translation: 冬天终于来了，对吧？幸好我们的假期大部分会在室内度过。

source: Either way, we have warm clothes packed.
translation: 不管怎样，我们带了保暖衣物。

source: *ehem* I told you guys~
translation: *咳咳* 我早就告诉你们了～

source: Brr… I can already feel the cold, even from in here!
translation: 嘶……就算坐在这里，我已经能感觉到寒冷了！

source: We still have a long way to go; the destination is in the capital, after all.
translation: 我们还有很长的路要走，毕竟目的地在首都。

source: Don’t worry, I brought my guitar along! We can pass the time with some carpool karaoke~!
translation: 别担心，我带了吉他！我们可以在车上唱歌打发时间～！

source: I hope you all know the lyrics to ‘Greatest Memories’!
translation: 希望你们都记得《最美好的回忆》的歌词！

source: To what…?
translation: 什么歌……？

source: *facepalms* Eugh…
translation: *捂脸* 呃……

source: Ugh, Yoshi… seriously?
translation: 呃，Yoshi……认真的吗？

source: Wh-What…? A little entertainment wouldn’t hurt, right?
translation: 怎、怎么了……？稍微娱乐一下没坏处，对吧？

source: I’m always down for a sing-along~!
translation: 我随时都愿意一起唱～！

source: Sing-along? We’re not campers anymore, Yoshi.
translation: 一起唱？我们已经不是营员了，Yoshi。

source: It’ll be just like having a campfire song.
translation: 就像唱篝火歌一样。

source: See? Sir Goro and Aiden have the camping spirit, even when we’re on a bus!
translation: 看吧？就算坐在巴士上，Goro先生和Aiden也有露营精神！

source: Give it up for ‘Camp Bus-sy’!
translation: 为“伙伴巴士营”欢呼！

source: Pfft—!!
Alright, come on everyone, I wanna hear you all sing~
translation: 好了，来吧，各位，我想听你们一起唱～

source: Ugh… This is gonna be a long ride…
translation: 呃……这会是一段漫长的路程……

source: {i}(I spent the next little while playing guitar and singing for everyone, and eventually, despite their protests, most of them got pretty into it!){/i}
translation: {i}（接下来一段时间，我弹着吉他为大家唱歌。尽管起初抗议不断，最后大多数人都唱得相当投入！）{/i}

source: {i}(It didn’t take long for the bus ride to make us all tired though, and we ended up falling asleep for the rest of the journey…){/i}
translation: {i}（不过没过多久，巴士旅程就让大家疲惫起来，最后我们在剩下的路上全都睡着了……）{/i}

source: {i}(We woke up to the sound of the bus pulling up to the hotel…){/i}
translation: {i}（巴士抵达酒店的声音把我们唤醒……）{/i}

source: Wow… Look at this place! It’s like we stepped into a whole new world!
translation: 哇……看看这里！就像踏入了一个全新的世界！

source: I-I sort of expected something fancy from just the exterior, but this is far more extravagant than I what was prepared for. Mr. Clermont has really outdone himself…
translation: 只、只看外观我就料到会很豪华，但这里的奢华远超我的心理准备。Clermont先生真的超越了自己……

source: How come you’ve never brought us somewhere like this before, Dad?!
translation: 爸爸，你以前为什么从没带我们来过这样的地方？！

source: Both the camp and I would go bankrupt if I did that, dear…
translation: 要是这么做，我和营地都会破产，亲爱的……

source: The architecture of this place is AMAZING! Just look at the intricate designs! Where do I begin? It’s a sensory overload!
translation: 这里的建筑太惊人了！看看那些精巧的设计！该从哪里说起？感官都快过载了！

source: It would take a real expert to conceptualize and deliver this level of craftmanship!
translation: 只有真正的专家，才能构思并实现这种水平的工艺！

source: Must be very expensive too.
translation: 肯定也非常昂贵。

source: That ceiling alone must have cost a fortune.
translation: 光是那片天花板肯定就价值不菲。

source: I only see these kinds of fancy places in movies. It feels so surreal to actually be in one.
translation: 我只在电影里见过这种豪华场所。真的身处其中，感觉太不真实了。

source: I know, right? Even the people walking around look hella rich… I kinda feel a little out of place here.
translation: 就是啊？连周围走动的人都看起来特别有钱……我在这里有点格格不入。

source: Yeah, the fact that we’re staying here almost makes me feel guilty, if I’m being honest.
translation: 是啊，老实说，一想到我们要住在这里，我甚至有些内疚。

source: I feel the same way…
translation: 我也有同感……

source: I’ve never been in a hotel as extravagant as this. I can only imagine how much Mr. Clermont spent on this trip…
translation: 我从没住过这么奢华的酒店。只能想象Clermont先生为这次旅行花了多少钱……

source: Hngh… I don’t even wanna think about that…
translation: 嗯……我都不敢去想……

source: Oh, come on guys, we’re here for a vacation! Mr. Clermont expects us to have fun and relax here!
translation: 哦，拜托，各位，我们是来度假的！Clermont先生希望我们在这里开心放松！

source: So, I’ll do just that! Hahaha! I’ll make sure every cent he spent on us is worth it~!
translation: 所以我就要这么做！哈哈哈！我会确保他花在我们身上的每一分钱都物有所值～！

source: ARGH! I’m so mad I didn’t bring my DSLR camera for this trip! I wanna take a bunch of pictures of the interior for my design references!!
translation: 啊！真气人，这次旅行我没带单反相机！我想拍一大堆室内照片作为设计参考！！

source: U-Umm… I brought one with me… If you want, I can take the pictures for you.
translation: 那、那个……我带了一台……如果你愿意，我可以替你拍照。

source: Oh, you’re a lifesaver, Jin! Take a picture of that chandelier, and that column over there, and oooh! That statue in the corner too!
translation: 哦，你真是救星，Jin！拍下那盏吊灯、那边的柱子，还有哦！角落里的雕像也要！

source: Give him a break, Lloyd. Jin might still be feeling car sick.
translation: 让他歇一会儿，Lloyd。Jin 可能还在晕车。

source: I-I’m fine…! Besides I already started taking pictures of you guys.
translation: 我、我没事……！而且已经开始给你们拍照了。

source: Oh my goodness, you must’ve caught our jaws dropping when we walked in…
translation: 我的天，你肯定拍到了我们进门时目瞪口呆的样子……

source: It’ll be good to document our experiences here. Besides, natural, candid shots are more fun to look at.
translation: 记录我们在这里的经历会很有意义。而且自然抓拍看起来更有趣。

source: Who knew Jin was also a photographer, haha!
translation: 谁知道 Jin 还是个摄影师，哈哈！

source: A-Ah, I only do it for fun… I just got into it because I started taking pictures of cosplayers at anime conventions.
translation: 啊、啊，我只是当作兴趣……因为开始在动漫展给角色扮演者拍照，才逐渐喜欢上的。

source: Kyaaa! You should show me those pics some time, Jin~! I bet there’s some super sexy ones!
translation: 呀啊！有空一定要给我看看那些照片，Jin～！我敢说里面有些超级性感！

source: *gulp* How did you know…
translation: *咽口水* 你怎么知道……

source: Haha, everyone seems really overwhelmed with the hotel, and we’re only in the lobby.
translation: 哈哈，大家似乎都被酒店震撼到了，而我们还只在大堂。

source: Yeah, no kidding. This place is almost too perfect.
translation: 是啊，真不是开玩笑。这里几乎完美得过头了。

source: Hnghhh…!! Why in the world is no one helping me with my luggage?!
translation: 嗯啊……！！为什么根本没人来帮我搬行李？！

source: Guess you spoke too soon, Aiden.
translation: 看来你高兴得太早了，Aiden。

source: A-Ah, Emilia, let me help you.
translation: 啊、啊，Emilia，我来帮你。

source: Don’t bother. There are people here paid to be doing this.
translation: 不必麻烦。这里有人拿钱专门做这件事。

source: What kind of service does this place have!? A bellboy should have helped me with my bags the moment we got off that shuttle!
translation: 这里到底是什么服务水平？！我们一下接驳车，就该有行李员来帮我拿包！

source: I can’t believe no one welcomed me either, do they even know who sent us here?! Where’s my room?! I thought this was a five-star luxury hotel?!
translation: 真不敢相信也没人来欢迎我，他们知道是谁把我们送来的吗？！我的房间在哪里？！这里不是五星级豪华酒店吗？！

source: I want to speak with the manager!!
translation: 我要见经理！！

source: Emilia, please calm down. You can see the staff are busy… Just wait for a little…
translation: Emilia，请冷静。你看得出工作人员都很忙……稍微等一下……

source: Told you she’s just gonna find something to complain about…
translation: 早就告诉你，她总会找点东西抱怨……

source: It’s a little embarrassing that she’s making a scene… a lot of people are starting to look at us…
translation: 她这样大闹有点丢人……很多人开始看我们了……

source: Yeah… I don’t think screaming like that makes the service any faster…
translation: 是啊……我觉得那样尖叫并不会让服务变快……

source: She’s a Karen.
translation: 她就是个刁蛮投诉狂。

source: I liked it better when she stayed quiet in the shuttle.
translation: 我更喜欢她在接驳车上保持安静的时候。

source: Greetings! Welcome to the Grand O’ Hotel. You deserve a release!
translation: 您好！欢迎来到大 O 酒店。您值得尽情释放！

source: Wow… Even the crew here have fancy taglines.
translation: 哇……连这里的员工都有花哨口号。

source: Ugh! It’s about time!
translation: 呃！总算来了！

source: Hello, we have a reservation made by Clermont Inc.
translation: 你好，我们有Clermont公司预订的房间。

source: Ah! Mr. Clermont’s party! One of our VIP Guests! We’ve been expecting you!
translation: 啊！Clermont先生的团队！尊贵的贵宾！我们一直在等各位！

source: Allow me to explain all the amenities included in your package!
translation: 请允许我介绍套餐中包含的所有设施！

source: Since you are VIP guests, your food, room, and entertainment are included in your stay, on top of priority access to all our facilities!
translation: 各位是贵宾，住宿期间的餐饮、客房和娱乐全部包含在内，还能优先使用所有设施！

source: Whoa… It sounds like we’re going to be treated like royalty here…
translation: 哇……听起来我们会在这里得到王室般的待遇……

source: Of course! This hotel offers maximum luxury, fit for kings and queens!
translation: 当然！本酒店提供极致奢华，足以款待国王与王后！

source: Finally. Something closer to home.
translation: 终于。有点像家了。

source: Now, Mr. Clermont has arranged four master king suites for the executive staff.
translation: Clermont先生为管理人员安排了四间豪华特大床套房。

source: Each room can accommodate up to four people. Here are your room keys, please feel free to divide your party as you see fit!
translation: 每间客房最多可容纳四人。这是房卡，请各位自行决定如何分组！

source: Once you all have decided, I’ll have our staff move your luggage to your rooms!
translation: 等各位决定后，我会让工作人员把行李送到房间！

source: If you need anything else, our front desk is available 24/7, so please don’t hesitate to call us!
translation: 如果还有任何需要，前台全天候服务，请随时来电！

source: Thank you, we’ll let you know if we need anything else.
translation: 谢谢，如果还有需要，我们会通知你们。

source: My pleasure~! I hope you all enjoy your stay here at the Grand O’.
translation: 我的荣幸～！祝各位在大 O 酒店住得愉快。

source: Wow… I was expecting that we’d all just stay in one room…
translation: 哇……我原以为大家只会住在一个房间……

source: Yeah… It seems a little overkill to give us four master king suites with a party of our size…
translation: 是啊……以我们团队的人数，安排四间豪华特大床套房似乎有点过头……

source: It’s Mr. Clermont we’re talking about after all…
translation: 毕竟说的是Clermont先生……

source: Anyway, there’s eight of us, so it’s only natural to split the rooms into pairs… Is everyone good with that?
translation: 总之，我们有八个人，两人一组分房最自然……大家都同意吗？

source: Pairs sound fun~ Me and Darius count as one!
translation: 两人一组听起来很有趣～我和Darius算一组！

source: I have no objection.
translation: 我没有异议。

source: As the only girl here… Do I have to, uhh… bunk with… her?
translation: 作为这里唯一的女孩……我是不是得，呃……和……她同住？

source: W-Well, I don’t mind sharing a room with you, Yuri… We can make up for the lost time on the bus ride watching BL.
translation: 这、这个，我不介意和你同住，Yuri……我们可以把巴士上错过的时间补回来，一起看 BL。

source: YES! YES! Good idea!
translation: 好！好！好主意！

source: *ehem* You’re my daughter so you’re staying with me. It’s been a while since we had some father-daughter bonding time.
translation: *咳咳* 你是我的女儿，所以和我住。我们已经很久没有父女相处的时间了。

source: Aww, Dad! Why did you have to pull the family card now…?
translation: 啊，爸爸！为什么偏偏现在拿亲情说事……？

source: C-Can anyone else stay with me…?
translation: 还、还有别人能和我住吗……？

source: That’s the nice way of saying “anyone but Ms. Emilia”, Jin.
translation: 这是在委婉地说“除了Emilia女士谁都行”，Jin。

source: Shh, Lloyd. She’s right over there.
translation: 嘘，Lloyd。她就在那边。

source: Hmph, bold of you people to assume I want to share a room with the likes of you!
translation: 哼，你们居然敢假设我想和你们这种人同住！

source: *snatches keys*
translation: *抢过房卡*

source: Just like at the camp, I require my own room, thank you very much.
translation: 就像在营地一样，我需要自己的房间，多谢。

source: I hate to stay and listen to your pointless bickering, so I’d best be on my way.
translation: 我不想留下听你们无意义的争吵，最好先走一步。

source: What a hog! She gets a room all to herself?!
translation: 真贪心！她一个人独占一间房？！

source: That might be for the best. I don’t think any of us would want to share a room with her in the first place.
translation: 这样也许最好。反正我觉得我们当中没人想和她同住。

source: Fair point.
translation: 说得有理。

source: Well, we don’t mind sharing a room with Jin. Right, Dar?
translation: 这个嘛，我们不介意和 Jin 同住。对吧，Dar？

source: I’m okay with a three-way.
translation: 我不介意三人行。

source: *gulp* W-Wahhh…
translation: *咽口水* 哇、哇啊……

source: JSKAJDKWQAK WHAT?!
translation: 叽里呱啦什么？！

source: Besides, we need a trusty cameraman to film exciting videos for us~
translation: 而且我们需要一位可靠的摄影师，替我们拍摄刺激的视频～

source: C-Cameraman?!
translation: 摄、摄影师？！

source: I-In the bedroom?!
translation: 在、在卧室里？！

source: Come, Jin.
translation: 来吧，Jin。

source: We’re gonna have some fun tonight!
translation: 今晚我们要好好玩！

source: That leaves Aiden and I sharing a room then!
translation: 那么就剩我和Aiden同住了！

source: Alright~ It’s about time the two of us got some privacy!
translation: 好啊～我们两个早该有点私人空间了！

source: WAIT, WAIT! If there’s gonna be action in BOTH of the other rooms, CAN I CHANGE ROOMS?!
translation: 等等，等等！如果另外两个房间都会上演好戏，我能换房吗？！

source: You’re coming with me.
translation: 你和我一起。

source: Nooooooo!!!!
Well, I’m glad Yuri’s back to normal at least.
translation: 至少很高兴Yuri恢复正常了。

source: Hahaha! You know she can’t resist when it comes to her fantasies!
translation: 哈哈哈！你知道面对那些幻想时，她根本忍不住！

source: You don’t exactly help with that either, you know.
translation: 你也完全没在帮她克制，知道吗。

source: Hey, it’s fun to tease her! And you for that matter~
translation: 嘿，逗她很有趣！逗你也是～

source: *ehem* A-Anyway, we should go check out our room.
translation: *咳咳* 总、总之，我们该去看看房间了。

source: Whoa… I guess I shouldn’t be surprised, but the room is luxurious too…
translation: 哇……虽然不该惊讶，但房间也非常豪华……

source: Just look at that view, it’s like we’re in the sky…!
translation: 看看那片景色，就像我们身在天空中……！

source: I don’t know if I can relax in some place as fancy as this… You know me, I’d rather be outdoors.
translation: 不知道自己能不能在这么豪华的地方放松……你了解我，我宁愿待在户外。

source: We’ve gotten so used to being surrounded by trees and staying in wooden cabins all the time, huh?
translation: 我们已经太习惯被树木环绕、一直住在木屋里了，对吧？

source: Yeah… Compared to Camp Buddy, this is a completely different world.
translation: 是啊……和伙伴营相比，这里是完全不同的世界。

source: {i}Aiden seems like he’s a little overwhelmed from all the luxury…{/i}
translation: {i}Aiden似乎有点招架不住这里的奢华……{/i}

source: {i}Aiden seems like he’s a little overwhelmed from all the luxury…{/i}{fast}
translation: {i}Aiden似乎有点招架不住这里的奢华……{/i}{fast}

source: We're on vacation.
translation: 我们正在度假。

source: Isn’t that a good thing, though? We’re on vacation, after all!
translation: 不过这不是好事吗？毕竟我们正在度假！

source: Yeah, you’re right… And I’ve been looking forward to spending some quality time with you, but I guess everything being so fancy caught me off guard…
translation: 是啊，你说得对……我一直期待和你度过珍贵时光，只是这里的一切都太豪华，让我措手不及……

source: Well, it’s no fun if we just stay in the room. Why don’t we go and check out what else we could do here?
translation: 只待在房间里可没意思。我们何不去看看这里还能做些什么？

source: They gave me a hotel brochure, so let’s take a look!
translation: 他们给了我一份酒店手册，我们看看吧！

source: We deserve the break.
translation: 我们值得好好休息。

source: It’s nice to take a break in a place like this every once in a while. We’re not going to stay here forever, after all.
translation: 偶尔在这种地方休息一下也很好。毕竟我们不会永远住在这里。

source: Let's do something fun.
translation: 我们做点有趣的事吧。

source: Why don’t we do something fun then, Aiden?
translation: 那我们何不做点有趣的事，Aiden？

source: Oho~ Looks like someone can’t wait to get the action going?
translation: 哦嚯～看来有人等不及要开始“行动”了？

source: W-What?! I-I meant around the hotel…
translation: 什、什么？！我、我是说在酒店里四处看看……

source: Whoa, I didn’t think you were the type who’d like to do it in public too!
translation: 哇，没想到你也是喜欢在公共场合做的人！

source: What I’m trying to say is that we should go explore and check out what kind of fun stuff is here!
translation: 我的意思是，我们应该去探索，看看这里有什么有趣的东西！

source: I know, I know, I’m just kidding, hahaha! You should see the look on your face!
translation: 知道，知道，我只是在开玩笑，哈哈哈！你真该看看自己的表情！

source: But you’re right, if we just stay in the room, we’ll probably get bored at some point.
translation: 不过你说得对，只待在房间里，早晚会觉得无聊。

source: Unless~
translation: 除非～

source: *ehem* So, they gave me this hotel brochure. Let’s check it out.
translation: *咳咳* 他们给了我这份酒店手册。我们看看吧。

source: Lay in bed with me.
translation: 陪我躺在床上。

source: Either way, we better make the most out of it.
translation: 不管怎样，我们最好充分利用这次机会。

source: Here, why don’t you lay down with me?
translation: 来，为什么不陪我躺下？

source: Wh-What—
translation: 什、什么——

source: Don’t mind if I do~!
translation: 那我就不客气了～！

source: *jumps into bed*
translation: *跳上床*

source: WHOA…!! These beds are damn soft… and the sheets even smell like flowers! Now, I could get used to this~
translation: 哇……！！这些床软得不得了……床单甚至还有花香！这个我倒能习惯～

source: Wait… what’s that stuck in the pillows?
translation: 等等……枕头里夹着什么？

source: Oh, this must be the hotel brochure. Let’s take a look.
translation: 哦，这一定是酒店手册。我们看看。

source: Damn, look at all this cool stuff! They have a spa, café, gym and, oooh! A bar!
translation: 天啊，看看这些好东西！这里有水疗中心、咖啡厅、健身房，还有，哦！酒吧！

source: Whoa… This place really has everything… You could live like a king if you had the money to stay here for the rest of your life…
translation: 哇……这里真的什么都有……只要有钱在这里住一辈子，就能过得像国王……

source: And all of these are free?!
translation: 而且这些全都免费？！

source: Apparently it’s all part of the package Mr. Clermont got for us…
translation: 显然这些都包含在Clermont先生为我们购买的套餐里……

source: So, where do you think we should go first?
translation: 那么，你觉得我们该先去哪里？

source: It’d be nice to relax a little bit, so how about we try the spa?
translation: 稍微放松一下会很不错，不如试试水疗中心？

source: Ooh! Good idea! I could really use that after a long trip!
translation: 哦！好主意！长途旅行后我正需要这个！

source: Sure thing! I’ve been wanting to check it out, too!
translation: 当然！我也一直想去看看！

source: Ahh~ That hits the spot!
translation: 啊～正中要害，太舒服了！

source: Yeah… I can’t remember the last time I took an actual bath… We’ve only had showers back at camp.
translation: 是啊……我都记不得上次真正泡澡是什么时候了……在营地只有淋浴。

source: I don’t know how they did it, but even the water here feels expensive…
translation: 不知道他们怎么做到的，连这里的水都感觉很昂贵……

source: I think they put some kind of lavender scent in it…
translation: 我想水里加了某种薰衣草香味……

source: I gotta say, it’s making me feel a little tingle, if you know what I mean~
translation: 我得说，它让我有点躁动，你懂我的意思吧～

source: *gulp* A-Aiden… There’s a lot of other people here…
translation: *咽口水* 艾、Aiden……这里还有很多其他人……

source: Oh! Look over there, Yoshi! Isn’t that—
translation: 哦！看那边，Yoshi！那不是——

source: Hey, Gramps!
translation: 嘿，Gramps！

source: Ah, I didn’t notice you two were here as well…
translation: 啊，我没注意到你们两个也在这里……

source: This place is so relaxing, I haven’t been paying much attention to anything else.
translation: 这里太令人放松，我没有怎么注意其他事。

source: Haha, I’m not too surprised that this is your kind of place, sir.
translation: 哈哈，这里正合您的喜好，我一点也不惊讶，先生。

source: I’ll admit, I’ve always been fond of bath houses… There’s something very soothing about them.
translation: 我承认，自己一直很喜欢澡堂……那里有种非常安抚人心的感觉。

source: This place here is on another level, though. Did you know they’ll serve you drinks while you’re in the water?
translation: 不过这里完全是另一个层次。你知道泡在水里时他们还会送饮料吗？

source: Whoa, you can do that?
translation: 哇，还可以这样？

source: Yes. Mostly herbal teas and other relaxing beverages, though.
translation: 是的。不过主要是花草茶和其他放松饮品。

source: They even offer massages. In fact, I’ve already booked one for after my soak.
translation: 他们甚至提供按摩。事实上，我已经预约了泡完澡后的按摩。

source: Wow Gramps, it sounds like you plan on spending the day here – making the most of it, right?
translation: 哇，Gramps，听起来你打算一整天都待在这里——充分利用，对吧？

source: Yes, although going to bathhouses isn’t new to me. Back in the day, I would go to one whenever I needed to release the stress of running the camp.
translation: 是的，不过去澡堂对我并不新鲜。从前每当需要释放管理营地的压力时，我都会去。

source: It was nowhere near as grand as this one, that’s for sure
translation: 当然，那里远没有这里这么豪华。

source: Hehe, are you sure you didn’t come here for a special kind of ‘release’?
translation: 嘿嘿，你确定不是来寻求某种特别的“释放”？

source: Hm? What are you trying to say?
translation: 嗯？你想说什么？

source: Oh, come on! People go to places like this looking for a ‘spicy’ kind of fun~
translation: 哦，拜托！人们来这种地方，就是为了寻找“火辣”的乐趣～

source: What? I’m just telling it like I see it!
translation: 怎么了？我只是实话实说！

source: Looking at the crowd, I can easily tell who’s only here for a good time.
translation: 看看人群，我轻易就能分辨谁只是来找乐子的。

source: *ehem* I did not come here to hook up with random strangers.
translation: *咳咳* 我不是来和陌生人随便勾搭的。

source: Some of them are pretty hunky. You sure you didn’t see anyone you fancy, Gramps?
translation: 有些人相当健壮。你确定没看到中意的人吗，Gramps？

source: Like I said, I only came here to relax.
translation: 就像我说的，我只是来放松。

source: There’s a proper time and place for that, Aiden.
translation: 那种事要讲究合适的时间和地点，Aiden。

source: Eh, I guess you really are too old for this kind of stuff. Just when I thought you were finally one of the cool kids for once…
translation: 呃，看来你真的太老，不适合这种事了。我还以为你终于能当一次酷小子……

source: A-Aiden, stop teasing Sir Goro…
translation: 艾、Aiden，别再逗Goro先生了……

source: I-I’ll have you know, two not-so-gentle men approached me earlier and asked me to join them in the sauna for a chat…!
translation: 告、告诉你们，之前有两个不怎么绅士的男人接近我，请我去桑拿房“聊聊”……！

source: Oh really? What happened then?
translation: 哦，真的？然后呢？

source: As soon as I stood up, they looked directly at my crotch and started asking for something else.
translation: 我一站起来，他们就直盯着我的胯部，开始提出别的要求。

source: A what now?
translation: 什么东西？

source: GAH! I get it, I get it, you don’t have to say it out loud, Aiden!
translation: 啊！我懂了，我懂了，不用大声说出来，Aiden！

source: *sigh* You’re insufferable…
translation: *叹气* 你真让人受不了……

source: Mr. Nomoru? The massage room is ready!
translation: Nomoru先生？按摩室已经准备好了！

source: Ah, just in time. Do you two want to come with me?
translation: 啊，来得正好。你们两个想和我一起吗？

source: Nope, I’m good! Not a real fan of massages. It gets too ticklish for me.
translation: 不了，我就算了！我不太喜欢按摩，觉得太痒。

source: That’s surprising. For someone as virile as you, I was sure you’d be into it. What do you and Yoshinori prefer then?
translation: 真让人意外。你这么精力旺盛，我还以为会喜欢。那么你和Yoshinori更喜欢什么？

source: That’s surprising. For someone as virile as you, I was sure you’d be into it. What do you and Yoshinori prefer then?{fast}
translation: 真让人意外。你这么精力旺盛，我还以为会喜欢。那么你和Yoshinori更喜欢什么？{fast}

source: Something quick.
translation: 快一点的。

source: We’d rather do something that doesn’t take too long.
translation: 我们更想做些不会花太久的事。

source: You mean a quickie, right? I’m down – let’s go right here and now!
translation: 你是说来一发速战速决，对吧？我愿意——现在就在这里开始！

source: I-I knew you were gonna say something like that…!
translation: 我、我就知道你会说这种话……！

source: Something filling.
translation: 能填满我们的。

source: I’d rather have something that fills me up.
translation: 我更想要能把自己填满的东西。

source: Oh, I’ll fill you up alright~! You wanna do it right here and now?
translation: 哦，我当然会把你填得满满的～！想现在就在这里做吗？

source: A-Aiden…!! I meant eating…!!
translation: 艾、Aiden……！！我是说吃东西……！！

source: Something that makes us sweat.
translation: 能让我们流汗的。

source: We’d rather do something that makes us sweat!
translation: 我们更想做些会让自己流汗的事！

source: Something rougher.
translation: 更粗暴一点的。

source: We’d rather do something rougher together.
translation: 我们更想一起做些粗暴一点的事。

source: *ehem* Well, if that’s the case, I’ll be on my way. You two have a good time.
translation: *咳咳* 既然如此，我先走了。你们两个玩得开心。

source: Guess I was wrong about Gramps. He’s not as stuck-up as I thought, ’cuz that massage definitely has a happy ending.
translation: 看来我看错Gramps了。他没我想的那么古板，因为那场按摩肯定有“快乐结局”。

source: Wh-What?! H-How could you tell
translation: 什、什么？！你、你怎么知道？

source: Didn’t you see the look on that masseur’s face when he called him? The guy was totally checking him out!
translation: 没看到那个按摩师叫他时的表情吗？那家伙明显在打量他！

source: And after he saw what Gramps was packing, that perv’s eyes were definitely sparkling.
translation: 看到Gramps胯下藏着什么后，那个色鬼的眼睛绝对在发光。

source: *sigh* Aiden, I don’t know how you think of all this…
translation: *叹气* Aiden，真不知道你怎么能想到这些……

source: {i}After Sir Goro left, Aiden and I continued to chat and soak in the bath.{/i}
translation: {i}Goro先生离开后，我和Aiden继续聊天泡澡。{/i}

source: {i}We were both so relaxed that we didn’t even notice how long we’d spent there, and by the time we got out, it was already sunset…{/i}
translation: {i}我们都太过放松，甚至没注意待了多久。等离开时，太阳已经落山……{/i}

source: {i}Our bodies were really pruney, and Aiden couldn’t resist poking me all over and teasing about it!{/i}
translation: {i}我们的身体都泡得皱巴巴的，Aiden忍不住到处戳我，还拿这件事开玩笑！{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, we decided to go and explore another area of the hotel! {/i}
translation: {i}最后，我们决定去探索酒店的另一个区域！{/i}

source: {i}We were both so relaxed that we didn’t even notice how long we’d spent there, and by the time we got out, it was already dark out…{/i}
translation: {i}我们都太过放松，甚至没注意待了多久。等离开时，外面已经天黑……{/i}

source: {i}It was already late, but we spotted one more place for us to go… {/i}
translation: {i}时间已经很晚，但我们发现还有一个地方可以去……{/i}

source: The café seems like it might be a nice place to hang out at!
translation: 咖啡厅看起来很适合消磨时间！

source: Ooh! Good idea! Those snacks were good on the ride, but I’m craving some real food!
translation: 哦！好主意！路上的零食不错，但我想吃真正的食物！

source: Sure thing! I’m curious what the food there is like, anyway!
translation: 当然！反正我也很好奇那里的食物怎么样！

source: Damn… Does every single place in this building have to be so extra?
translation: 天啊……这栋建筑里的每个地方都非得这么夸张吗？

source: I mean just look at that view… You can see the entire city from here…
translation: 我是说，看看那片风景……从这里能看到整座城市……

source: I guess it lives up to its name as the best hotel around…
translation: 看来这里不愧是附近最好的酒店……

source: Oh, and isn’t that Yuri over there?
translation: 哦，那边不是Yuri吗？

source: Let’s see what she’s up to.
translation: 去看看她在做什么。

source: Hi, Yuri!
translation: 嗨，Yuri！

source: Oh, hello there, Yoshi, Aiden!
translation: 哦，你们好，Yoshi、Aiden！

source: I’m pretty surprised to see you both here! A café doesn’t seem like your style.
translation: 看到你们两个来这里真让我惊讶！咖啡厅不像是你们的风格。

source: Heeeey, what’s that supposed to mean?
translation: 喂——，这是什么意思？

source: Haha, we were just looking around for a place to hang out! Staying in our room can get boring, after all.
translation: 哈哈，我们只是四处找个地方消磨时间！毕竟一直待在房间里会无聊。

source: The moment I saw this on the brochure, I had to go check it out!

source: Oho~ Wanting someone else to take charge?
translation: 哦嚯～想让别人掌控一切？

source: Oho~ Wanting to take control, Yoshi?

source: KYAAA! Yes, take him right now, Yoshi! Assert yourself!
translation: 呀啊！没错，现在就上了他，Yoshi！展现你的主导地位！

translation: *叹气* 你们两个别太投入了。

source: And do you guys really think it’s okay to talk about this kind of stuff out in public…?
translation: 而且你们真的觉得在公共场合谈这种事没问题吗……？

source: *ahem* A-Anyway, what else have you been up to, Yuri? It’s been a while since you’ve had time for yourself like this.
translation: *咳咳* 总、总之，你还做了些什么，Yuri？你已经很久没有这样属于自己的时间了。

source: Yeah, and I’ve just been hanging out here at the café! I think this will be my chill spot for the trip~
translation: 是啊，我一直在咖啡厅里闲逛！我想这里会成为旅行期间的放松据点～

source: It’s quiet and peaceful, and there’s no big distractions like work!
translation: 这里安静祥和，也没有工作那样的重大干扰！

source: The only thing that’s still irritating me is Emilia being on the trip with us. But I guess you can’t have everything, huh?
translation: 唯一仍让我烦恼的是Emilia也和我们同行。不过人总不能事事如愿，对吧？

source: She really does push your buttons, doesn’t she?
translation: 她真的很容易惹怒你，对吧？

source: I just don’t understand how she can get away with so much… I mean, I know she’s a QA manager but she always demands the most unnecessary stuff!
translation: 我就是不明白她怎么能一直为所欲为……我知道她是质量保证经理，可她总提出最没必要的要求！

source: You were getting super cranky with her this morning when we were checking in.
translation: 今天早上办理入住时，你对她特别暴躁。

source: Who wouldn’t be annoyed at that?! If I had to listen to her Karen-ing for another minute—
translation: 谁不会被她惹恼？！要是再让我听一分钟她那投诉狂式的抱怨——

source: Now, now, Yuri. We’re here to relax, so don’t get worked up again.
translation: 好了，好了，Yuri。我们是来放松的，别又激动起来。

source: Hmph! It’s because you changed the topic!
translation: 哼！都怪你换了话题！

source: But seriously, it could’ve been worse. Compared to how she was the last few months, this is pretty tame.
translation: 不过说真的，情况本来可能更糟。和过去几个月相比，她现在算很收敛了。

source: I guess that’s true… I was almost sure she’d flip out when nobody wanted to share a room with her.
translation: 我想也是……没人愿意和她同住时，我几乎确定她会大发雷霆。

source: Maybe that meeting yesterday was a reality check for her.
translation: 也许昨天的会议让她认清了现实。

source: Although, something’s been bugging me…
translation: 不过有件事一直困扰我……

source: Eh? What is it?
translation: 咦？什么事？

source: Well, isn’t she, like, super rich? Like born-and-raised-rich? That was her whole shtick back then!
translation: 这个嘛，她不是超级有钱吗？就是那种从小富到大的？那可是她当年的全部人设！

source: Why would she keep working at a job where no one likes her?
translation: 为什么还要继续做一份没人喜欢她的工作？

source: And from the way she’s been acting, she hates the job too.
translation: 而且从她的表现来看，她自己也讨厌这份工作。

source: Now that you mention it, yeah…
translation: 你这么一说，确实……

source: Hehe… Maybe she’s just trying to score with Yoshi.
translation: 嘿嘿……也许她只是想追到Yoshi。

source: *sigh* That’s not funny…
translation: *叹气* 这不好笑……

source: But I’m calling it right now, there’s something really off about that girl… And I’m not just talking about her attitude!
translation: 不过我现在就敢断言，那个女人真的很不对劲……而且不只是态度！

source: I… don’t think we should be gossiping about her like this… It might just make things worse.
translation: 我……觉得我们不该这样议论她……这可能只会让事情更糟。

source: Let’s just give her the b—
translation: 我们还是姑且相——

source: “Benefit of the doubt”. Yeah, you’ve said that like a hundred times already, Yoshi.
translation: “相信她一次”。是啊，这话你已经说过上百遍了，Yoshi。

source: Either way, I’m keeping a close eye on her!
translation: 不管怎样，我会密切盯着她！

source: Won’t that mess up your vacation?
translation: 那不会毁掉你的假期吗？

source: It’s not like Emilia’s gonna be at Camp Buddy forever, you know! Just endure her ’til we finish the project!
translation: Emilia又不会永远待在伙伴营！只要忍到项目结束！

source: See? That’s the healthy way of thinking about it!
translation: 看吧？这才是健康的思考方式！

source: A-Anyway, I’m sorry for changing subjects, why don’t we go back to what we were talking about before?
translation: 总、总之，抱歉换了话题，我们回到之前谈的内容吧？

source: OMG! Alright, I have tons more fanfics of all different genres! Let’s find the one that suits you the best!!
translation: 天啊！好，我还有大量不同类型的同人小说！找出最适合你的那一篇吧！！

source: *sigh* I meant about the café, but sure, why not…
translation: *叹气* 我说的是咖啡厅，不过好吧，何乐不为……

source: {i}Thankfully, Yuri was eager to talk about her fanfics, so she was distracted from her concerns with Emilia…{/i}
translation: {i}幸好Yuri很想谈自己的同人小说，因此暂时忘记了对Emilia的担忧……{/i}

source: {i}We ended up sitting and chatting with her for a long time, eating snacks and laughing at all the stories she told.{/i}
translation: {i}最后我们和她坐着聊了很久，吃着点心，为她讲的各种故事大笑。{/i}

source: {i}Before we realized, it was already sunset, and we decided to check out another area of the hotel! {/i}
translation: {i}不知不觉太阳已经落山，我们决定去看看酒店的另一个区域！{/i}

source: {i}Before we realized, it was already dark out, but we spotted one more place for us to go… {/i}
translation: {i}不知不觉外面已经天黑，但我们发现还有一个地方可以去……{/i}

source: Why don’t we check out the gym, Aiden?
translation: 我们何不去看看健身房，Aiden？

source: Ooh! Good idea! My muscles need some stretching after sitting on that bus for hours!
translation: 哦！好主意！在巴士上坐了几个小时，我的肌肉需要拉伸！

source: Sure thing! My muscles could use a stretch!
translation: 当然！我的肌肉正该拉伸一下！

source: Wow… Check out all the fancy equipment they have here!
translation: 哇……看看这里所有的高级器械！

source: It must be easy to bulk up when you’ve got a place like this!
translation: 有这种地方，增肌一定很容易！

source: Haha, I’d run out of money way before I had any gains to show from a membership at this gym.
translation: 哈哈，在这家健身房办会员，我肯定还没练出成果就先破产了。

source: Besides, do you really need all these contraptions? I think I’ve done pretty good with just a couple weights and some body workouts!
translation: 而且真的需要这些复杂器械吗？我只用几副重量和自重训练，也练得相当不错！

source: Well, we’re already here! It won’t hurt to try at least one of them, right?
translation: 反正已经来了！至少试一台也没坏处，对吧？

source: Hehe, I guess, you’re right! What do you wanna work on?
translation: 嘿嘿，我想你说得对！你想练哪里？

source: Hehe, I guess, you’re right! What do you wanna work on?{fast}
translation: 嘿嘿，我想你说得对！你想练哪里？{fast}

source: Biceps.
translation: 肱二头肌。

source: Why don’t we try this curl machine? It looks like it focuses on your biceps!
translation: 我们试试这台弯举机怎么样？看起来专门锻炼肱二头肌！

source: Oh, arms, huh? I’m kinda surprised you wanna work on those, Yoshi!
translation: 哦，手臂啊？你想练这里，有点让我惊讶，Yoshi！

source: You tryin’ to get crazy ripped guns like Gramps?
translation: 你想练出Gramps那样夸张的肌肉大炮吗？

source: W-Well, I thought it would be easier to carry stuff around if I was stronger.
translation: 这、这个，我想如果更强壮，搬东西会轻松一些。

source: Fair enough. You could lift me around better that way~
translation: 有道理。那样你就能更轻松地把我举来举去～

source: A-Anyway, I actually used to work out on something like this back in college!
translation: 总、总之，我上大学时其实用过类似器械锻炼！

source: Haha, alright, sure! Show me the how it’s done!
translation: 哈哈，好啊！让我看看该怎么做！

source: Pecs.
translation: 胸肌。

source: Why don’t we try this press machine? It focuses on your pecs!
translation: 我们试试这台推举机怎么样？它专门锻炼胸肌！

source: *sigh* You heard that from Yuri, didn’t you?
translation: *叹气* 这是从Yuri那里听来的，对吧？

source: Yup! Hahaha!
translation: 没错！哈哈哈！

source: Abs.
translation: 腹肌。

source: Why don’t we try that crunch machine? It focuses on your abs!
translation: 我们试试那台卷腹机怎么样？它专门锻炼腹肌！

source: Oooh, really going for that washboard look, huh, Yoshi?
translation: 哦，真想练出搓衣板一样的腹肌，对吧，Yoshi？

source: I don’t blame you, though! I know you like to ogle mine, so I make sure they’re strong and solid for you~
translation: 不过我不怪你！我知道你喜欢盯着我的看，所以一定会为你把它们练得强壮结实～

source: A-Ah, well… I didn’t realize you noticed how often I look at them.
translation: 啊、啊，这个……没想到你注意到我经常看。

source: Hahaha! I pay attention~
translation: 哈哈哈！我很留心的～

source: Well, you’re always distracting me with yours, so I figured I should return the favor.
translation: 你总用自己的腹肌让我分心，所以我想也该回敬一下。

source: Anyway, I actually used to work out on something like this back in college!
translation: 总之，我上大学时其实用过类似器械锻炼！

source: Oh, so that’s how you got jacked! Count me in, then!
translation: 哦，原来你是这样练壮的！那也算我一个！

source: Glutes
translation: 臀肌。

source: Why don’t we try this squat machine? It focuses on your glutes!
translation: 我们试试这台深蹲机怎么样？它专门锻炼臀肌！

source: You tryin’ to clap those cheeks, Yoshi? All you had to do was ask~
translation: 你想让那两片屁股拍起来吗，Yoshi？开口问就行～

source: Whaaat? Not my fault you’re so easy and fun to tease~
translation: 什——么？你这么好逗又这么有趣，可不是我的错～

source: But hey, I wouldn’t say no to seeing you with a juicier butt~
translation: 不过，我可不会拒绝看到你的屁股变得更丰满～

source: Maybe then the scouts would call me Buttcheeks too, huh?
translation: 也许到时童子军也会叫我“Buttcheeks”，对吧？

source: A-Anyway, I actually just noticed this one because I used to work out on something like it in college!
translation: 总、总之，我只是因为上大学时用过类似器械，才注意到这一台！

source: Oh! Hold that thought Yoshi, it’s Darius!
translation: 哦！先等等，Yoshi，是Darius！

source: Huh, looks like he’s headed into that exercise room…
translation: 嗯，看来他正走进那间训练室……

source: Chat with Darius
translation: 和Darius聊天

source: Let’s go and say hi to him!
translation: 我们去打个招呼吧！

source: Join Darius’ workout (DLC)
translation: 加入Darius的训练（DLC）

source: Maybe we should join him! We’re about to start a workout anyway!
translation: 也许我们该加入他！反正正准备开始锻炼！

source: Heyyy, Darius, my man! How’s it going?
translation: 嘿——，Darius，兄弟！怎么样？

source: Building up those muscles I see!
translation: 看来正在锻炼肌肉！

source: Yes. I didn’t want to skip a day of my routine.
translation: 是的。我不想漏掉一天例行训练。

source: Where’s Lloyd? I thought you were with him.
translation: Lloyd在哪里？我以为你和他在一起。

source: He’s busy taking pictures of the building.
translation: 他正忙着给建筑拍照。

source: Oh, I see…!
translation: 哦，明白了……！

source: Why do you ask?
translation: 为什么问这个？

source: Ah well, I’m just not used to seeing you without Lloyd.
translation: 这个嘛，我只是不习惯看到你身边没有Lloyd。

source: You two are usually stuck together like glue – it’s weird seeing you apart!
translation: 你们两个通常像胶水一样黏在一起——分开时看起来很奇怪！

source: We both have different hobbies, and I like for him to spend time doing what he enjoys.
translation: 我们有不同的爱好，我希望他能花时间做自己喜欢的事。

source: He’s quite the energetic person, huh…?
translation: 他是个很有活力的人，对吧……？

source: Yes, he is. He’s always eager and ready to try something new. It’s something I admire about him.
translation: 是的。他总是热切地准备尝试新事物。这正是我欣赏他的地方。

source: How about you, Darius? Don’t you have a hobby?
translation: 你呢，Darius？没有爱好吗？

source: Building.
translation: 建造。

source: That’s your main thing, bro! A job doesn’t count!
translation: 那是你的本职工作，兄弟！工作不能算！

source: It has to be something that you do just for fun~
translation: 必须是纯粹为了乐趣而做的事～

source: I know it’s boring. I don’t have any ‘fun’ hobbies.
translation: 我知道很无聊。我没有任何“有趣”的爱好。

source: Really? There must be something you do outside of work that always makes you happy!
translation: 真的吗？工作之外一定有某件总能让你开心的事！

source: Lloyd, maybe?
translation: 也许是Lloyd？

source: Y-You’re happy when you’re doing… Lloyd?
translation: 你、你在“做”……Lloyd时会开心？

source: I mean, I’m happy when Lloyd is around.
translation: 我的意思是，Lloyd在身边时我很开心。

source: Everything is less interesting without him, so I prefer it when he’s with me.
translation: 没有他，一切都会变得没那么有趣，所以我更喜欢他陪着我。

source: *ehem* You know, I’ve been wondering about this for a while, but…
translation: *咳咳* 你知道吗，有件事我已经好奇一阵了，不过……

source: Is there a reason, why you’re always so quiet?
translation: 你总是这么安静，有什么原因吗？

source: Not really. It’s just the way I am.
translation: 没有。只是我本来就是这样。

source: Yoshi, you don’t just ask people why they’re quiet, it’s like asking someone why they never shut up.
translation: Yoshi，不能随便问别人为什么安静，这就像问一个人为什么从不闭嘴。

source: A-Ack, I apologize! I wasn’t trying to be rude!
translation: 啊、啊，抱歉！我不是故意无礼！

source: Don’t worry. I didn’t take any offense from it.
translation: 别担心。我没有觉得被冒犯。

source: It’s nothing new anyway. People call me ‘Serious Darius’ for a reason.
translation: 反正也不新鲜。人们叫我“严肃的Darius”是有原因的。

source: They’re either scared of me or think I’m boring.
translation: 他们要么怕我，要么觉得我无聊。

source: Wha— but that’s not true at all, Darius! I’ve always thought you were interesting!
translation: 什——但完全不是这样，Darius！我一直觉得你很有趣！

source: Besides, you’ve got that mysterious vibe going for you that makes people want to get to know you more~!
translation: 而且你身上有种神秘气质，让人想进一步了解你～！

source: Thanks for the compliment, but…
translation: 谢谢夸奖，不过……

source: Nobody really approaches me.
translation: 其实没人会接近我。

source: D-Doesn’t that upset you…?
translation: 那、那不会让你难过吗……？

source: Not really. I prefer it that way.
translation: 不会。我更喜欢这样。

source: I guess it does make sense though. You’re so tall and buff, so being quiet on top of that can come off intimidating to others.
translation: 不过这也说得通。你又高又壮，再加上沉默寡言，对其他人来说可能很有威慑力。

source: Good to know it works. It helps me protect Lloyd.
translation: 很高兴知道有效。这样能帮我保护Lloyd。

source: Eh? What do you mean?
translation: 咦？什么意思？

source: Lloyd is the complete opposite of me. He has interesting hobbies, he’s not as tall and he likes to talk a lot.
translation: Lloyd和我完全相反。他有有趣的爱好，没那么高，而且很喜欢说话。

source: That made him an easy target for bullies in the past. Which made him cry often.
translation: 过去这让他很容易成为霸凌者的目标，常常被弄哭。

source: And I couldn’t protect him.
translation: 而我没能保护他。

source: …I never knew.
translation: ……我从来不知道。

source: Even as adults, many people in our industry underestimate him or don’t give him the respect he deserves.
translation: 即使成年后，行业里仍有许多人低估他，不给予他应得的尊重。

source: They stop doing those things whenever they see me with Lloyd.
translation: 每当看到我和Lloyd在一起，他们就不再那样做。

source: That’s why I try my best to be his bodyguard. And make sure he always has a smile on his face.
translation: 所以我尽力做他的保镖，确保他脸上始终带着笑容。

source: Aww… Now if that isn’t the sweetest thing I’ve ever heard, I don’t know what is!
translation: 啊……如果这还不是我听过最甜蜜的事，那真不知道什么才是！

source: That’s very chivalrous of you, Darius… Lloyd is a lucky person then!
translation: 你真有骑士精神，Darius……Lloyd很幸运！

source: I’m the lucky one.
translation: 幸运的人是我。

source: Haha, it’s really nice to talk with you like this, Darius!
translation: 哈哈，像这样和你聊天真好，Darius！

source: You probably don’t notice it, but… You tend to speak a lot whenever we talk about Lloyd.
translation: 你大概没注意到，不过……每当谈起Lloyd，你都会说很多话。

source: I’m sorry if it weirded you out.
translation: 如果让你们觉得奇怪，我很抱歉。

source: No, no, it’s actually charming, bro~!
translation: 不，不，其实很迷人，兄弟～！

source: Yes! I feel like we’re one step closer to trusting each other, too!
translation: 是啊！我觉得我们也离互相信任更近了一步！

source: I’m glad. I’ll try to be more open with you guys. It’ll take some time getting used to.
translation: 我很高兴。我会试着对你们更敞开心扉，不过需要时间适应。

source: We’ll be here all day~! Now come on, let’s work up a sweat!
translation: 我们整天都会在这里～！来吧，让我们挥汗锻炼！

source: {i}We spent the rest of the afternoon working out with Darius and chatting… I really enjoyed seeing him open up like that!{/i}
translation: {i}下午剩余时间里，我们与Darius一起锻炼聊天……看到他这样敞开心扉，我真的很开心！{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, Lloyd came looking for us and we realized it was already sunset! {/i}
translation: {i}最后Lloyd来找我们，我们才意识到太阳已经落山！{/i}

source: {i}We decided to finish up our workout, take a quick shower, and check out another place in the hotel!{/i}
translation: {i}我们决定结束训练，快速冲个澡，再去看看酒店的另一个地方！{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, Lloyd came looking for us and we realized it was already dark out! {/i}
translation: {i}最后Lloyd来找我们，我们才意识到外面已经天黑！{/i}

source: {i}We decided to finish up our workout, take a quick shower, and check out one more place in the hotel that I spotted… {/i}
translation: {i}我们决定结束训练，快速冲个澡，再去看看我发现的酒店中另一个地方……{/i}

source: Why don’t we go check on our friends?
translation: 我们何不去看看朋友们？

source: Ooh! Good idea! Maybe they’re up to something fun!
translation: 哦！好主意！也许他们正在做有趣的事！

source: Sure thing! I could use some chill time after earlier!
translation: 当然！经历刚才那些事，我正需要放松一下！

source: O-Oh…! I’m coming!
translation: 哦、哦……！我来了！

source: Hey there, Jin!
translation: 嗨，Jin！

source: A-Ah, hey guys, please come in!
translation: 啊、啊，嗨，各位，请进！

source: Eh? Where is everybody?
translation: 咦？其他人在哪里？

source: Oh, if you’re looking for Lloyd and Darius, they already went downstairs to do stuff around the hotel.
translation: 哦，如果你们在找Lloyd和Darius，他们已经下楼去逛酒店了。

source: Don’t you wanna go out too? We could all go together if you want!
translation: 你不想出去吗？如果愿意，我们可以一起！

source: I-It’s alright! I’m not really the type to go out and party. I’m fine just staying in a cozy room like this!
translation: 没、没关系！我不太喜欢出去聚会。像这样待在舒适的房间里就很好！

source: B-Besides, my stomach is still recovering from the bus ride this morning.
translation: 而、而且我的胃还没从早上的巴士旅程中恢复。

source: Oh, you still feel a little sick?
translation: 哦，你还是有点不舒服？

source: I hope we didn’t bother you!
translation: 希望我们没有打扰你！

source: N-Not at all! I was just resting!
translation: 完、完全没有！我只是在休息！

source: Yikes, do you still feel sick from the bus ride this morning?
translation: 天啊，早上坐巴士的不适还没好吗？

source: Yeah… it kinda takes a while before its gone…
translation: 是啊……通常要过一阵才会消失……

source: Well, I hope you don’t mind if we hang out here with you then!
translation: 那希望你不介意我们留在这里陪你！

source: O-Oh no, I wouldn’t want you guys to miss out on all the fun stuff around the hotel!
translation: 哦、哦，不，我不希望你们错过酒店里那些有趣的东西！

source: Nah, it’s fine! We kinda needed to rest a little anyways!
translation: 没事！反正我们也有点需要休息！

source: What do you usually do for fun though, Jin?
translation: 不过你平时会做什么取乐，Jin？

source: I-It depends… I have several definitions of fun...
translation: 这、这要看情况……我对“乐趣”有好几种定义……

source: Oho~
translation: 哦嚯～

source: W-Well, I remember that you enjoy the same stuff as Yuri. But is there something else that maybe… you know? We could do together?
translation: 这、这个，我记得你喜欢和Yuri一样的东西。不过有没有别的什么……你懂的？我们能一起做？

source: Hahaha! Now we’re talking, Yoshi!
translation: 哈哈哈！这才对嘛，Yoshi！

source: *sigh* Don’t put words in my mouth, Aiden…
translation: *叹气* 别曲解我的话，Aiden……

source: What? Do you want us to put something else in there?
translation: 怎么？你想让我们把别的东西塞进你嘴里？

source: Oh my…
translation: 哎呀……

source: H-How about we do something with your computer, Jin?! You use that for fun too, right?
translation: 我、我们用你的电脑做点什么怎么样，Jin？！你也会用它娱乐，对吧？

source: Yes, I read my BL there.
translation: 是的，我会在电脑上看 BL。

source: Okay, I give up…
translation: 好吧，我放弃……

source: W-Well, I also play games and watch anime on it, if that’s the answer you’re looking for…
translation: 这、这个，我也会用它玩游戏、看动漫，如果你想听的是这种答案……

source: Y-Yeah! Why don’t we do that?
translation: 是、是啊！我们就做这个吧？

source: Oh! Actually, we could continue with that journal project maybe? I had a lot of fun last time we did it together!
translation: 哦！其实也许可以继续那个日记项目？上次一起做时我很开心！

source: Bro. You fell asleep in less than fifteen minutes.
translation: 兄弟。你不到十五分钟就睡着了。

source: I-I promise I’ll stay up this time!
translation: 我、我保证这次会保持清醒！

source: Wow… I never knew you guys had to do this much work every day…
translation: 哇……我从不知道你们每天要做这么多工作……

source: Ah, yes. When you have to feed a hundred people three times a day, it takes a lot of time and effort.
translation: 啊，是的。每天要为一百个人准备三餐，会花费大量时间和精力。

source: I dunno how Dad did it all by himself before either.
translation: 我也不知道爸爸以前怎么一个人完成。

source: Haha! It is much easier with you two around!
translation: 哈哈！有你们两个在，确实轻松多了！

source: A-Ahehe… I’m just chopping up veggies though… I’m not very good at cooking, haha.
translation: 啊、啊嘿嘿……不过我只是在切蔬菜……我不太会做饭，哈哈。

source: It’s alright! It saves us a lot of work!
translation: 没关系！这替我们省了很多功夫！

source: Haha, and it’s always been one of Aiden’s least favorite tasks, so I’m sure he’s happy to pawn it off on a friend~
translation: 哈哈，而且这一直是Aiden最不喜欢的任务之一，所以他肯定很高兴能推给朋友～

source: D-Dad! Shhh!
translation: 爸、爸爸！嘘！

source: By the way, Aiden. Is your sauce ready? I need it over here.
translation: 对了，Aiden。酱汁准备好了吗？我这里需要。

source: Oh! Sure thing, pops!
translation: 哦！当然，老爸！

source: Aiden, don’t go so fast—
translation: Aiden，别走那么快——

source: WHOA!
translation: 哇！

source: And there goes the sauce.
translation: 酱汁就这样洒了。

source: Yikes. Sorry, Dad.
translation: 糟糕。抱歉，爸爸。

source: Ahehe… You’re always so clumsy, Aiden.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……你总是这么笨手笨脚，Aiden。

source: You should know Aiden’s quite talented when it comes to tripping and falling by now.
translation: 你现在应该知道，Aiden在绊倒和摔跤方面很有天赋。

source: Anyway, let me take this shirt off before it stains.
translation: 总之，趁污渍还没留下，我把衬衫脱掉。

source: W-Woah, what’s that?
translation: 哇、哇，那是什么？

source: Hmm? What is it, Yoshinori?
translation: 嗯？怎么了，Yoshinori？

source: I’m just surprised you have another tattoo, Mr. Andre. And it’s a big one too.
translation: 我只是很惊讶您还有另一处纹身，Andre先生。而且还很大。

source: Oh, this? Yep! It’s something I got in my younger years, before Aiden was around, haha.
translation: 哦，这个？没错！是我年轻时、Aiden出生前纹的，哈哈。

source: My dad was a gangster, you know?
translation: 你知道吗？我爸爸以前是黑帮分子。

source: Wah! Really?!
translation: 哇！真的吗？！

source: *sigh* No, of course not. Aiden’s being silly.
translation: *叹气* 不，当然不是。Aiden在胡闹。

source: Sheesh… You could’ve gone along with it for a minute, dad.
translation: 天啊……爸爸，你就不能配合一分钟吗？

source: It looks like a lizard. Does it stand for anything?
translation: 看起来像蜥蜴。有什么含义吗？

source: It means positivity, flexibility and regeneration, three things that matter when facing challenges in life!
translation: 它代表积极、适应与重生，这三点在面对人生挑战时非常重要！

source: When I look at this tattoo, I remember that things will always look up.
translation: 看到这个纹身，我就会记得事情总会好转。

source: Wow! That’s really inspiring!
translation: 哇！真的很鼓舞人心！

source: Right? That’s why I wanna get a lizard like that too, but Dad keeps stopping me!
translation: 对吧？所以我也想纹一只那样的蜥蜴，可爸爸一直阻止我！

source: He always talks about how painful it would be to get it done, but I could take it!
translation: 他总说纹身会有多痛，可我能承受！

source: You’re leaving out the most important reason though, Aiden.
translation: 不过你漏掉了最重要的原因，Aiden。

source: A tattoo is a lifelong mark, and you’ll carry it with you forever. You have to make sure there’s a good reason to get it, or it’ll be a huge regret for you down the line.
translation: 纹身是一生的印记，会永远伴随你。必须确保有充分理由，否则将来会非常后悔。

source: You can’t just get one ’cause your old man has one!
translation: 不能只因为你老爸有一个就去纹！

source: Hmph, I already have one on my wrist! You didn’t care about that!
translation: 哼，我手腕上已经有一个了！你根本没在意！

source: That’s different from a giant lizard on your shoulder, son.
translation: 那和肩膀上一只巨大的蜥蜴不一样，儿子。

source: Yeah, Aiden… Are you sure you’d want something that big? Everyone would see it all the time!
translation: 是啊，Aiden……你确定想要那么大的吗？所有人都会一直看到！

source: If it’s not gonna be seen then what’s the point?
translation: 如果没人看到，那还有什么意义？

source: Even if it was on my butt, I’d want the whole world to see!
translation: 就算纹在屁股上，我也想让全世界都看到！

source: Aiden! That’s too far!
translation: Aiden！说得太过了！

source: Hahaha! Yoshinori, I’m glad you’re around to be a voice of reason for my son here.
translation: 哈哈哈！Yoshinori，很高兴有你在这里劝我儿子保持理智。

source: Do me a favor and watch over him so that he doesn’t sneak off and get one behind my back.
translation: 帮我看着他，别让他背着我偷偷去纹。

source: Y-Yes, sir! You can count on me!
translation: 是、是的，先生！您可以依靠我！

source: Hey, that’s no fair using Yoshi against me!
translation: 喂，利用Yoshi来对付我不公平！

source: I just realized something… Did you trick us into working on our vacation?!
translation: 我刚意识到一件事……你是不是骗我们在假期里工作了？！

source: W-Well… Not exactly…
translation: 这、这个……不完全是……

source: Hey, at least we had fun, Aiden.
translation: 嘿，至少我们玩得很开心，Aiden。

source: Okay, now you guys have to listen to me! We’ll have some REAL fun out there!
translation: 好，现在你们得听我的！我们要去外面享受真正的乐趣！

source: Hnn… But my tummy’s still turning…
translation: 嗯……可我的胃还在翻腾……

source: Nice try, Jin. You just don’t wanna leave this room, huh?
translation: 这借口不错，Jin。你只是不想离开房间，对吧？

source: Haha, let Jin be, Aiden. As long as he’s enjoying his vacation, then he can do whatever he wants!
translation: 哈哈，随 Jin 去吧，Aiden。只要他享受假期，想做什么都行！

source: Fine! But one of these days, you’re gonna be out partying with the rest of us!
translation: 好吧！不过总有一天，你得出来和我们一起狂欢！

source: {i}As we left Jin to rest, we suddenly realized that it was already sunset!{/i}
translation: {i}让 Jin 留下休息后，我们突然意识到太阳已经落山！{/i}

source: {i}We decided to go check out another area of the hotel before it got dark.{/i}
translation: {i}我们决定趁天黑前去看看酒店的另一个区域。{/i}

source: {i}As we left Jin to rest, we suddenly realized that it was already dark out, but we spotted one more place for us to go… {/i}
translation: {i}让 Jin 留下休息后，我们突然意识到外面已经天黑，不过还发现了一个可以去的地方……{/i}

source: Maybe we can go back to the lobby?
translation: 也许可以回大堂？

source: The lobby? Did you forget something?
translation: 大堂？你忘了什么东西吗？

source: Not really. I just don’t have any other ideas.
translation: 没有。我只是想不到其他地方。

source: I guess that’ll kill some time. Sure, why not!
translation: 那也能打发时间。好啊，为什么不呢！

source: Sooo… Why exactly are we back here again?
translation: 那——么……我们到底为什么又回到这里？

source: Oh, crap, Emilia’s here too! Quick, Yoshi, let’s scram!
translation: 糟糕，Emilia也在！快，Yoshi，我们溜吧！

source: Huh… I thought she’d be in her room… I wonder what she's doing here by herself.
translation: 咦……我以为她会待在房间……不知道一个人在这里做什么。

source: Probably waiting to speak with the manager again…
translation: 大概又在等着见经理……

source: *sigh* She’s gonna cause a commotion if we don’t stop her.
translation: *叹气* 不阻止她，她会闹起来的。

source: Wait… Don’t tell me you’re gonna go and talk to her?
translation: 等等……别告诉我你要去和她说话？

source: Well, only to make sure she’s not going to get herself in trouble.
translation: 只是确保她不会给自己惹麻烦。

source: Ahehe… You really are too nice, Yoshi.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……你真的太善良了，Yoshi。

source: Don’t worry, I’ll make it quick.
translation: 别担心，我会很快。

source: Hey there, Emilia.
translation: 嗨，Emilia。

source: *gasp*
translation: *吸气*

source: Goodness fucking gracious! How dare you sneak up on me like that!
translation: 我的老天爷！你竟敢那样偷偷接近我！

source: A-Ah, I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to.
translation: 啊、啊，对不起。我不是故意的。

source: What the hell do you want?
translation: 你到底想干什么？

source: I was just passing by and happened to see you here.
translation: 我只是路过，碰巧看到你在这里。

source: What are you doing all by yourself?
translation: 你一个人在做什么？

source: Now all of a sudden you’re interested? It’s none of your business. Leave me alone.
translation: 现在突然有兴趣了？不关你的事。别来烦我。

source: Come on, Emilia… We’re on a vacation… Do you really want to spend your time here being sour?
translation: 拜托，Emilia……我们正在度假……你真想一直闷闷不乐地度过吗？

source: For your information, I was having a good time before you came along.
translation: 告诉你，在你出现之前我玩得很开心。

source: W-Well I just thought you'd enjoy some company.
translation: 这、这个，我只是觉得你可能会喜欢有人陪。

source: I don’t need other people to enjoy a vacation! Especially now that I’m finally in a place up to my standards.
translation: 我不需要别人也能享受假期！尤其现在终于来到符合我标准的地方。

source: Either way, you know where to find me.
translation: 不管怎样，你知道去哪里找我。

source: Would you stop that already?!
translation: 你能不能别再这样了？！

source: Wh-Wha… Stop what…?
translation: 什、什么……别怎样……？

source: You know what you’re doing! You’re acting like that goody-two-shoes scout that pretends to care about everything!
translation: 你清楚自己在做什么！又装成那个关心一切的老好人童子军！

source: I know better now than to get tricked by fake people like you!
translation: 我现在已经不会再被你这种虚伪的人欺骗！

source: Emilia… That’s not—
translation: Emilia……不是——

source: If you came here to ruin my oh-so-perfect-day. Congratulations, you just did.
translation: 如果你来这里是为了毁掉我无比完美的一天，恭喜，你成功了。

source: Sheesh... I knew that was a bad idea.
translation: 天啊……我就知道那是个坏主意。

source: Yeah, I don’t even know why I tried.
translation: 是啊，我甚至不知道自己为什么还要尝试。

source: I know you just wanna help, but you just can't change some people, Yoshi...
translation: 我知道你只是想帮忙，但有些人就是无法改变，Yoshi……

source: I just can't help but think about how almost everyone gave up on her when we were scouts.
translation: 我就是忍不住想起我们当童子军时，几乎所有人都放弃了她。

source: And even though we're much older, she's still stuck in her ways.
translation: 即使现在年长许多，她仍然执迷不悟。

source: And I'm worried that if I stop trying, then who will?
translation: 我担心如果自己也不再尝试，还会有谁？

source: Ah, I’m sorry, Aiden! I didn't mean to dig so deeply into that.
translation: 啊，对不起，Aiden！我不是故意钻得这么深。

source: We should be trying to do something fun out here.
translation: 我们在外面应该做点有趣的事。

source: Ahehe… Yeah…
translation: 啊嘿嘿……是啊……

source: Alright, let’s check out where we should go next!
translation: 好，看看下一站该去哪里！

source: Oh, look! They have a bar here, Aiden!
translation: 哦，快看！这里有酒吧，Aiden！

source: Now you’re talking! Let’s grab some drinks, then!
translation: 这才对嘛！那我们去喝几杯！

source: Although I don’t think it’s included in our room package, unlike the other areas.
translation: 不过和其他区域不同，我觉得酒水不包含在客房套餐里。

source: Aww… That’s a bummer.
translation: 啊……真扫兴。

source: Don’t worry, though! It’s my treat!
translation: 不过别担心！我请客！

source: Wah, really, Yoshi?! Let’s go then!!
translation: 哇，真的吗，Yoshi？！那就走吧！！

source: H-Hey, wait for me…!!
translation: 喂、喂，等等我……！！

source: This place is… interesting… It’s nothing like the bars we go to back home!
translation: 这个地方……很有意思……完全不像我们家乡的酒吧！

source: I mean… look at all those servers and dancers! They sure know how to entertain their guests, huh?
translation: 我是说……看看那些服务员和舞者！他们真懂得怎么招待客人，对吧？

source: Yeah, this place is a lot more like a party club than a casual pub…
translation: 是啊，这里更像派对夜店，而不是休闲酒馆……

source: Considering how fancy everything was so far, I think that’s what they were going for!
translation: 考虑到目前一切都那么华丽，我想这正是他们追求的效果！

source: Hello! Welcome to Bottom’s Up!  We pride ourselves on our ‘top’ service!
translation: 您好！欢迎来到“翘臀干杯”！我们以“顶级”服务为荣！

source: What can I get you two fine gentlemen? Fancy a drink?
translation: 两位英俊的先生想要什么？来杯酒吗？

source: Fine gentlemen, I like the sound of that~
translation: 英俊的先生，我喜欢这个称呼～

source: Uh… We’re fairly new here, so we don’t really know what to get…
translation: 呃……我们第一次来，不太知道该点什么……

source: Of course! I’d be happy to help you out~ What liquor do you usually fancy? Rum? Whiskey? Tequila?
translation: 当然！很乐意帮忙～你们平时喜欢什么酒？朗姆、威士忌还是龙舌兰？

source: Uh… We usually just drink canned beer.
translation: 呃……我们通常只喝罐装啤酒。

source: Do you really want canned beer in a place like this? Take a look at our menu~!
translation: 在这种地方真的要喝罐装啤酒吗？看看菜单～！

source: Oof... Help me out here, Yoshi…
translation: 唔……帮帮我，Yoshi……

source: {i}(Looking at the options… Aiden would like…){/i}
translation: {i}（看看这些选项……Aiden应该会喜欢……）{/i}

source: {i}(Looking at the options… Aiden would like…){/i}{fast}
translation: {i}（看看这些选项……Aiden应该会喜欢……）{/i}{fast}

source: Eh, what’s that?
translation: 咦，那是什么？

source: H-Honestly, I have no idea…
translation: 老、老实说，我也不知道……

source: It’s cream liqueur mixed with sambuca!
translation: 是奶油利口酒混合桑布卡酒！

source: S-Sambuca…?
translation: 桑、桑布卡……？

source: W-Well, let’s just try it, Aiden!
translation: 这、这个，试试看吧，Aiden！

source: I guess we should’ve brought Gramps with us, huh…? He usually knows these kinds of things…
translation: 看来我们该把Gramps带来，对吧……？他通常懂这些东西……

source: Sit on my Face.
translation: 坐我脸上。

source: How about you try ‘Sit on my Face’, Aiden?
translation: 你试试“坐我脸上”怎么样，Aiden？
